title: curation export --json (schema 1.0)
description: Exports passed (review episodes included, held excluded) into export/lerobot_curated/ (design doc 02, section 3.7; doc 06, section 4); an mcap source into export/mcap_curated/ and a lance source into export/lance_episodes/ (D44, always a full export).

manifest.description: path of export/manifest.json, relative to the run directory

videos_copied.description: video files whose bytes were copied from the source

videos_reencoded.description: video files produced by encoding (v3 files that lost or gained an episode)

videos_renamed.description: v2 videos only renumbered: renamed in place, no bytes copied

full_reason.description: why an --incremental run fell back to a full export (interrupted last export, missing or changed files, other format or parameters); null otherwise

dataset_dir.description: the delivered dataset, relative to the run directory: export/lerobot_curated (default when absent), export/mcap_curated or export/lance_episodes (D44)

note.description: what people should know about this delivery; lance: the native lance delivery is not done (episodes_parquet and videos instead)
